# ADR-3091: A08: Mutable tag deploy reference for release 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Floating tags can be retargeted silently.

## Decision

Deployments MUST NOT use a mutable tag deploy reference for release 7 (A08-7) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Immutable digests pin what runs.
